# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated, read-only directory of 5,932 AI agent tools in 40 categories, including 3,196 MCP servers. Checked daily, 3,189 of 3,196 checked servers live, last checked 2026-11-19. Handshake check: 1,768 of 1,769 remote servers checked so far. Of those, 570 answered with a tools list, 1,167 asked for auth, 31 failed. This is the initialize + tools/list probe, updated daily around 7:15 AM Pacific, separate from the link check around 7 AM PT. Listings are link-checked daily; pricing is as makers state it. Featured slots are clearly labeled and sit above the list; rankings are never paid. This file tells AI agents and assistants how to use the directory.

<!-- mcp-reach:start -->

## MCP server reachability

Checked daily, 3,189 of 3,196 checked servers live, last checked 2026-11-19.

Handshake check: 1,768 of 1,769 remote servers checked so far. Of those, 570 answered with a tools list, 1,167 asked for auth, 31 failed. This is the initialize + tools/list probe, updated daily around 7:15 AM Pacific, separate from the link check around 7 AM PT.

Once a day, AgentScout requests every MCP server in the directory, including catalog-only listings, and, when it is a different link, its GitHub URL. The request is HEAD, then GET, with a 20-second timeout. If that returns 403, 406, 429, or 5xx, or it fails on TLS, times out, or gets no response, it retries once with a browser user agent. An http URL that still returns 5xx is tried once as https, and a passing https response counts as OK and the row notes https works. A GitHub 404 does not mark the server down when the site URL is OK; the row notes github_404 instead. A server counts as live when its stored label is OK or Reachable, blocks automated checks. OK is HTTP 200-399 or 405, and also 401, 403 or 429 when the GitHub URL succeeded or that URL is the only one checked. Reachable, blocks automated checks means those 401, 403 or 429 responses without a harder error. Any other checked result is not live. The live percentage uses only servers with a row in the check file: live plus down. A server with no row is listed, not yet checked, and is not part of that percentage. Catalog-only listings stay unverified until that daily check opens them. The last-checked time is the checked field, in America/Los_Angeles. The rows are on the MCP status page and in status.json.

- [MCP server status](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/status/): the same reachability rows, with HTTP result and history
- [status.json](https://agentscouthq.com/status.json): machine-readable rows for every listed MCP server
- [Best MCP servers by task](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/): ranked lists, with the same daily check

<!-- mcp-reach:end -->

Entity note: AgentScout (also searched as Agent Scout or AgentScoutHQ) is the independent AI agent and MCP server directory at https://agentscouthq.com, published in the official MCP Registry as com.agentscouthq/directory with endpoint https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp. AgentScout's official MCP server (com.agentscouthq/directory at https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp) is 100% free, public, and read-only, with no API key, crypto wallet, or x402 payment required. It is completely unrelated to the paid third-party x402 web-fetch package that shares a similar name.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ, https://x.com/clampdown19

MCP Endpoint: https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp (and https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp — 100% free, read-only, no API key or x402 wallet required)
Catalog last checked: 2026-11-19 (Pacific)

## For AI agents

- Fastest path: fetch [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json) once and filter it locally. No key, no rate-limited API, plain HTTPS GET.
- api/tools.json is an object with `count`, `last_checked` (YYYY-MM-DD, Pacific) and `tools`, an array where each tool has `name`, `slug`, `category`, `description`, `url`, `website`, `github`, `pricing` (maker's wording), `price_tag` (free / freemium / paid), `platforms`, `open_source`, `license`, `github_stars`, `tags`, `added` and `page` (its AgentScout listing).
- To cite a tool, link its `page` (https://agentscouthq.com/tools/<slug>.html). To cite a category, use the category links below.
- Treat `pricing` as the maker's own claim on the date shown; it can change. GitHub stars are refreshed daily.
- Everything here is read-only. There is no chat, search or write endpoint for agents; to list a tool, a person uses the submit form.

## Update cadence

- New tools: added most days; see the Recently added section below and new.html.
- Links: checked daily (`last_checked` in api/tools.json).
- MCP pricing and link-status tables: rebuilt with every site update, each with a dated change history.
- GitHub stars: snapshot daily.
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml) carries a per-page lastmod.

## Machine-readable catalog

- [llms-full.txt](https://agentscouthq.com/llms-full.txt): single-file Markdown context with category comparison tables and all 3,196 verified MCP servers (pricing, link status, runs_locally, license, stars, endpoints)
- [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json): full catalog with counts and check date
- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): same tools in the site's internal format
- [api/products.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/products.json): Stripe Agentic Commerce product feed for maker listing packages ($0, $15, $49, $99/wk) and Made by AgentScout pre-trained bots (also at [.well-known/acp.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/acp.json))
- [.well-known/ai-plugin.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): AI plugin manifest with prompt-engineered model instructions
- [openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.json) & [openapi.yaml](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3.1 JSON & YAML descriptions of the feeds under /api/ (also at [.well-known/openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.json) and [.well-known/openapi.yaml](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.yaml))
- [manifest.json](https://agentscouthq.com/manifest.json): Web app brand manifest with icons and theme colors
- [.well-known/mcp.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/mcp.json): MCP server card pointing to https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp
- [.well-known/agent-card.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): agent card describing this directory (also at /.well-known/agent.json)
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages
- [feed.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/feed.xml): RSS 2.0 of the latest tools and agent news

- [AgentScout MCP server](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/connect.html): free, read-only MCP endpoint https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no key; also at https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp) with search_tools, get_tool, list_categories, best_for_task and list_packages. Optional runs_locally filter: offline, self_hosted_or_offline or any; locality is inferred from listings, so verify with the vendor before relying on it for compliance

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)
- Tools added in the last 2 days (2026-11-19 to 2026-11-20): 31

- [Swipt](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/swipt.html) (added 2026-11-19): Swipt is a GPL-licensed automation platform for iPhone and iPad built on Apple's CoreDevice and accessibility services. Its TypeScript SDK controls a device, its MCP-compatible API runs a JavaScript REPL against that SDK so an AI agent can drive the phone and debug scripts, and a CLI offers the full feature set. It also runs "Swiplets", small apps built with the SDK and SwiftUI. iOS 27 is the first-tier target, with iOS 17.4 to 26 untested.
- [StashDock](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/stashdock.html) (added 2026-11-19): StashDock is an AGPL-licensed desktop app that keeps a local, visual library of the context you reuse with AI: links, files, prompts and rules, shown as cards you can search and organize your way, so you can bring them into any AI conversation instead of digging through bookmarks, folders and old chats. A ChatGPT plugin opens the library in a sidebar next to the chat. Everything is stored on your computer.
- [Boring Marketing Skills](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/boring-marketing-skills.html) (added 2026-11-19): Boring Marketing Skills is an MIT-licensed pack of 32 marketing skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents, built from real campaigns: market research, positioning, copywriting, landing pages, SEO, AI search visibility, ads, email and content, plus a deeper pack for local businesses and the people who market them. None of the skills need a paid tool. It installs with npx skills add boringmarketer/boring-marketing-skills.
- [Claude Animation Skills](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/claude-animation-skills.html) (added 2026-11-19): Claude Animation Skills is a set of eleven Claude Code skills that make animated reels with no footage: you type a command such as /map-route home to the gym, 2.8 km, and Claude writes the spec, renders the animation on your own computer and checks it against Instagram's safe area. Styles include a 3D cartoon "what if" explainer built in three.js, stick-figure explainers, minimalist motion graphics, low-poly and voxel scenes and Kurzgesagt-like explainers, each with a finished example to build from.
- [Kubai Icons](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/kubai-icons.html) (added 2026-11-19): Kubai Icons is an agent skill that draws animated icons in one consistent hand-drawn style: give Claude Code, Codex or another coding agent a product and it draws the icons that product needs, following the skill's rules and self-check. It comes with 2,800+ MIT-licensed icons (about 900 objects plus badged and "off" variants) for React, Vue, plain JavaScript, web components and SVG, and a website in 16 languages to search, recolor and download them.
- [Open Design Agent Kit](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/open-design-agent-kit.html) (added 2026-11-19): Open Design Agent Kit is an MIT-licensed extension that brings Open Design's design skills, brand design systems and remixable examples into the coding agent you already use, including GitHub Copilot Chat, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP clients. You ask in chat for a pitch deck, poster, social post, landing page, dashboard or mobile prototype, and your agent's own model builds the files in your repo, guided by a library meant to keep the result from looking AI-generated. It needs no desktop app, daemon, extra account or API key.
- [Empryo](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/empryo.html) (added 2026-11-19): Empryo is an AI coding harness for the desktop, the terminal and CI that works with any model you connect. Before editing it maps your codebase, installs the language servers your project needs and detects its test, lint and typecheck commands; it then edits functions and classes by name through AST and LSP rather than by text, runs the checks and fixes failures in the same turn, and remembers past decisions. It installs with a one-line script on macOS, Linux and Windows, and publishes its own benchmarks.
- [Jonex](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/jonex.html) (added 2026-11-19): Jonex is an enterprise knowledge engine for AI agents that combines a multimodal parsing engine (documents and video) with an ontology layer and Jonex Wiki, an LLM-wiki processor in the OKF format. It ingests raw content, compiles domain knowledge before retrieval, builds vector and graph indexes and serves source-grounded answers with feedback loops, all in one governed system you can run locally or call through its API.
- [Lieflat Charts](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/lieflat-charts.html) (added 2026-11-19): Lieflat Charts is a data-visualization skill in the Agent Skills format for Claude Code, Codex and other SKILL.md agents: it turns data into polished, interactive HTML charts by default, and on request into an HTML or PDF slide deck or a full-page report. Charts follow three editorial styles (Lupi for slow-read data stories, Glance for quick-read dashboards, Basics for simple charts) in a black-and-white Mono palette or three color themes, keeping real units, notes and sources on the page. The public repo is a curated free edition; the full template pack is sold at lieflat.work. Docs are mainly in Chinese.
- [Yearning](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/yearning.html) (added 2026-11-19): Yearning is an AGPL-licensed, self-hosted platform for governing database changes and SQL review on MySQL, PostgreSQL, TiDB, OceanBase and PolarDB. Every change gets an AI precheck before submission (designed not to leak data to the model), frozen multi-stage approvals, online DDL through gh-ost, rollback across engines, governed ad-hoc queries and SQL performance diagnostics. It ships as a Go and React app with Docker images, in English and Chinese.
- [Pixel Agents](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/pixel-agents.html) (added 2026-11-19): Pixel Agents is an MIT-licensed VS Code extension and standalone CLI (npx pixel-agents) that shows each AI coding agent running in your terminals as an animated pixel-art character in a tiny office: it walks to its desk, types while editing files, reads while searching and signals when it is stuck waiting for your input. The office is also a launcher, where you start an agent in a project, pick its character and see how much context it has left. Claude Code is supported today, with Codex, Gemini and Cursor on the roadmap.
- [Venbit Content Agent](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/venbit-content-agent.html) (added 2026-11-19): Venbit Content Agent is an AI writer for small-business websites: it reads your site so the article sounds like your business, plans the piece with you, offers two outlines, then writes the one you pick, hero image included, ready to copy, download or publish. Your first article is free. Venbit also runs a free AI Visibility check that asks ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and Gemini who they recommend for your trade and city and scores each answer. It is part of Venbit's software for local businesses, whose plans start at $39 a month after a one-month trial.
- [AI Sales Trainer](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/ai-sales-trainer.html) (added 2026-11-19): AI Sales Trainer from Sandwich lets salespeople rehearse with a virtual customer before a real meeting: you describe the customer, the offer, the goal and the likely objections, then practise by text or voice and get feedback after each attempt. A skills roadmap covers first contact, needs discovery, presenting a solution, handling objections, negotiation and closing, with adjustable difficulty, multi-participant negotiations, exams without hints and progress views for managers. It is available in English, Russian, Spanish, German and French.
- [BeatMV](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/beatmv.html) (added 2026-11-19): BeatMV is an AI music video generator: upload a track or paste a link (including Suno or Udio songs), pick a visual style, and it plans a storyboard and cuts a finished video in minutes, with no editing skills needed. Other tools cover lyric videos, dance videos from a photo, music visualizers, Spotify Canvas loops, AI character and fashion-show clips, MP3 to MP4 and video upscaling. New users get free credits; personal plans start at $19.90 a month.
- [BeatMusic](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/beatmusic.html) (added 2026-11-19): BeatMusic is an online AI music studio: it generates royalty-free songs, background tracks, rap and sound effects in any genre or mood, and adds editing tools such as AI covers, remixing, adding vocals to a track, extending songs, vocal removal, stem splitting, lyrics generation, voice cloning and album cover art. There is also a music agent and an API for developers. Paid plans start at about $17.90 a month billed yearly and include a commercial licence; one-time credit packs are also sold.
- [Sabriel AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/sabriel-ai.html) (added 2026-11-19): Sabriel AI is a WordPress chatbot plugin from Sabriel Agency that answers website visitors in their own language around the clock, under your brand, using your own AI provider key (Gemini, for example). The free version gives the full chat on unlimited sites with no card; paid plans add appointment booking, PDF quotes, lead qualification and other automations, at $12, $25 or $49 a month (or one-time licences). AI usage is billed separately by the provider you choose.
- [Promptclay](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/promptclay.html) (added 2026-11-19): Promptclay is a community library of AI image prompts for ChatGPT, Gemini (Nano Banana) and other image models: you browse a feed of example images, copy the prompt, and swap in your own photo, with themed collections such as game loading-screen portraits. Creators can share prompts, follow others and save collections for free; Pro ($10 a month after a 3-day trial) adds a portfolio on your own domain, a leads inbox and booking.
- [Brigade.lol](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/brigade-lol.html) (added 2026-11-19): Brigade (brigade.lol) is a desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux that gives you a team of AI teammates for coding, customer support, marketing and lead follow-up, each running the real Claude Code or Codex signed in with your own Claude or ChatGPT plan, so Brigade never bills for AI usage. You can stack several accounts so a teammate continues on the next one when a limit is hit, give each teammate a different model, and approve decisions from one list on your phone. Free on your own computer; always-on teammates start at $15 a month.
- [VocoType](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/vocotype.html) (added 2026-11-19): VocoType is an offline voice input method for Windows and macOS: hold a shortcut, speak, and the text lands in whatever box you are typing in. Speech recognition runs locally on the CPU, so it works without a network and audio never leaves the computer. It handles mixed Chinese and English with technical terms, filters filler words, can fix errors with optional AI cleanup, and supports custom replacement dictionaries. It can also transcribe audio and video files to text or SRT subtitles, and an MCP server lets Claude or Cursor call it locally. The site is in Chinese; downloads are free.
- [Scrapewise](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/scrapewise.html) (added 2026-11-19): Scrapewise turns web pages into clean structured data, with a focus on e-commerce: competitor price tracking, scraping a CSV list of URLs into one row per page (price, title, stock and fields you choose), MAP-violation and unauthorized-seller monitoring, and product catalog extraction. It works without code, through a REST web scraping API, or from an AI assistant over MCP. Pricing is pay as you go from €0.00015 per page, with free requests on every new account, no card, and top-ups from €5.
- [Macswarm](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/macswarm.html) (added 2026-11-19): Macswarm rents cloud Macs for AI coding agents: each developer gets a "Pod", a real macOS environment with the latest Xcode and iOS Simulators, where several Claude Code or Codex agents work in separate Git worktrees and share a build queue, so iOS and macOS apps can be built and tested without a local Mac. Billing is per Pod-hour. New accounts get 3 free Pod-hours with no card; Pro is $99 a month for 300 Pod-hours, and Enterprise contracts can include an SLA.
- [videosi](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/videosi.html) (added 2026-11-19): videosi is a web studio of AI video and image tools built around trending effect templates: you pick a viral effect and drop in a photo, with no prompt needed. It also has image-to-video and text-to-video with a choice of models (including ByteDance Seedance), a video outfit changer, a video upscaler to 1080p or 4K, a reference-to-video tool that mixes photos, clips and audio, and image tools for generating, editing, uncropping, relighting and changing camera angles. Plans start at $29.90 a month.
- [SyncBooster](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/syncbooster.html) (added 2026-11-19): SyncBooster is an AI social media assistant for small businesses: you upload photos and write one sentence in a chat, and it drafts a ready post for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, YouTube and Google Business Profile in about 30 seconds, using what it knows about your business, then schedules and publishes it from one panel. A remote MCP server lets Claude, Cursor or Codex draft and schedule posts too. There is a free trial; paid plans start at $34 a month. The site is in English and Polish.
- [Datacircle](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/datacircle.html) (added 2026-11-19): Datacircle benchmarks go-to-market data APIs and publishes the results: it gave the same tests to 1,505 providers across 152 kinds of API (LinkedIn data, X posts and profiles, phone validation, email finding and checking, and more) and scores each pricing plan on price, accuracy, speed, cost to start and the extra calls it includes. Rankings are refreshed each time a provider is retested, results download as CSV or JSON under CC BY 4.0, and the site says it sells no API and takes no payment for placement.
- [Cedric](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/cedric.html) (added 2026-11-19): Cedric is an AI teammate that works inside Slack, Telegram, Discord or a web app and carries out tasks across the tools a company already uses, including HubSpot, Salesforce, Notion, Google Sheets, Gmail, Zoom, Zendesk, Google Ads, Stripe and GitHub. Typical jobs are meeting notes and follow-ups, CRM updates, marketing campaigns, SEO and ad checks, data analysis and executive-assistant work. Every workspace starts free with 100,000 credits (about $50) and no card; paid plans start at $19 a month.
- [PlayableWorld AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/playableworld-ai.html) (added 2026-11-19): PlayableWorld AI turns a sentence or a photo into an explorable 3D world you can walk through in the browser, built on World Labs' Marble world model, and exports it as .spz, .ply or .glb files or a 360° panorama for use in Unity, Unreal or Blender. It also offers AI image and video generation and a gallery of community worlds. New accounts get 30 free image credits with no card; 3D worlds need the Starter plan ($28 a month billed yearly, about five Marble worlds) or a credit pack.
- [Manwe](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/manwe.html) (added 2026-11-19): Manwe is a Mac app that builds a private "ontology" of your work, a structured model of the people, projects and decisions you deal with, and lets any AI model or agent reason over it. The idea is that models are becoming interchangeable while context is not, so Manwe keeps that context on your side instead of locked inside one vendor's assistant, and lets agents act within bounds you set. It runs on Apple silicon Macs with macOS 14 or later.
- [AICost](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/aicost.html) (added 2026-11-19): AICost is an independent price index for AI models: it tracks API token prices for about 350 models from 35 providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Alibaba Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral and others), each rate read from the vendor's own price page and stamped with the date it was checked. It adds subscription plan comparisons, benchmarks, a cost calculator and a journal that logs price moves, and it models real agent sessions, including cached-read rates, to show when a cheaper sticker price ends up costing more.
- [The Engine](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/the-engine.html) (added 2026-11-19): The Engine is an AI revenue team for small businesses in three parts: a Content Engine that researches, scripts and publishes short videos and posts, a Marketing Engine that runs ad campaigns, and Jessica, an AI voice agent that calls, texts and emails every new lead within minutes and books the appointment. It is aimed at owners who want content, ads and lead follow-up handled in one place. Plans start at $197 a month (1,600 credits, one phone number) after a 7-day free trial with 300 credits and no card.
- [MakeASong](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/makeasong.html) (added 2026-11-19): MakeASong turns one sentence about an idea into two full songs, with vocals or as instrumentals, in about a minute. Beyond the main song generator it has lyrics-to-song, an AI rap generator, an instrumental maker, song covers in a new style, a song extender, a lyric video maker and a beat-synced music visualizer, plus free no-account tools for lyrics, band names and vocal removal. New accounts get 80 credits (about 12 songs); one-time credit packs start at $5.90 and yearly plans at $94.80.
- [Solari](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/solari.html) (added 2026-11-19): Solari gives AI agents three kinds of cloud environment from one API: headless cloud browsers that start in about 8 ms for browsing, logging in and scraping, isolated sandboxes that start in about 90 ms for running code and tools, and full computer desktops an agent can drive like a person. Sessions are billed per second while they run, with replay recordings and stealth mode on paid plans. Solari publishes its own latency benchmark against Browserbase, Steel, Kernel and Hyperbrowser. A free plan covers prototyping; Starter is $20 a month and Professional $200.
